info.name: Lab Unity API
info.description:
Role + feature organized collection matching frontend (`web/src/api/httpEndpoints.js`) and backend modules (`server/src/modules/{admin,supplier,user}`).

## Structure
- **Auth** — register / login / refresh / logout / forgot + reset password / auth me
- **Public** — health, blog read, subscription plans
- **Admin** — dashboard, statistics, settings, users, profile, blogs, reports, ads review, marketplace/recruitment/general moderation
- **Supplier** — ads, marketplace, recruitment, general, blogs (read), contacts, notifications, messages, profile, uploads; Dashboard = composed requests only
- **User** — profile, feed, contacts, marketplace (browse + own listings), recruitment (browse + own jobs), general, messages, notifications, ads browse, subscriptions, reports, search, blogs, uploads

## Variables
`baseUrl` (default `http://localhost:4000/api/v1`), `accessToken`, `adminToken`, `sellerToken`, `customerToken`, plus entity IDs (`messageId`, `sessionId`, …).

## Notable query filters
- Contacts: `status` (pending|accepted|declined), `direction` (incoming|outgoing), `country`, `search`
- Feed / General / Marketplace / Recruitment / Ads: `mine`; Marketplace also `saved`; Recruitment also `since` (7d|30d|90d)
- Notifications: `unread`
- Search: `q` (required), `types`, `limit`

## Removed / not invented
- Old nested **Dashboard > Admin/Supplier/Customer** mega-folder (duplicated other folders) — removed.
- Duplicate **Platform Settings** under Admin (kept under Settings only).
- **No** Supplier `GET /dashboard` or Admin “recent activity” — those APIs do not exist.
- Frontend `ADMIN.MANAGE_USERS` → `/admin/users` is **not** a real route (users are under `/users`). Marked by omission.
- Stripe webhook `POST /subscriptions/webhook` is server-only (raw body + Stripe signature) — not included.

## Auth headers
Collection default Bearer `{{accessToken}}`. Role folders override with `adminToken` / `sellerToken` / `customerToken`. Login test script fills the matching role token when `user.role` is present in the login response.

item.name: Auth
item.description: Shared authentication for all roles. No Bearer token except Get Current User.

request.description:
Create a new account.

**Auth:** none (rate-limited)
**Body:** firstName, lastName, email, password, confirmPassword, profileType, acceptedTerms (+ optional profile fields)
**Status:** 201

body.raw:
{
  "firstName": "Jane",
  "lastName": "Doe",
  "email": "jane.doe@example.com",
  "password": "Secret123!",
  "confirmPassword": "Secret123!",
  "profileType": "laboratory",
  "jobTitle": "Lab Manager",
  "company": "Acme Labs",
  "country": "Germany",
  "phone": "+49123456789",
  "professionalInfo": "10 years in clinical diagnostics",
  "acceptedTerms": true
}

request.description:
Exchange credentials for tokens. Test script saves `accessToken` / `refreshToken` and mirrors into `adminToken` | `sellerToken` | `customerToken` based on role.

**Auth:** none (rate-limited)
**Status:** 200

Rotate access + refresh tokens.

**Auth:** none
**Body:** `{ refreshToken }`
**Status:** 200

Email a single-use password reset link (`{CLIENT_URL}/reset-password?token=...`). Always returns the same message whether or not the email is registered. Issuing a new link invalidates older unused ones. Without SMTP configured (dev), the email is logged to the server console.

**Auth:** none (rate limited)
**Body:** `{ email }`
**Status:** 200

Set a new password using the token from the reset email. The token is single-use and expires after `PASSWORD_RESET_TTL_MINUTES` (default 30). All existing sessions (refresh tokens) are revoked.

**Auth:** none (rate limited)
**Body:** `{ token, password, confirmPassword }` — password: 8+ chars, uppercase, number, symbol
**Status:** 200 · 400 invalid/expired token · 422 validation

JWT session summary (id, role, email). Distinct from `GET /users/me` (full profile).

**Auth:** Bearer any role
**Status:** 200

item.description: Unauthenticated / optional-auth endpoints used across roles.

request.description:

**Query:** page, pageSize, sort, search, category

item.name: Admin
item.description:
Admin panel surface. Folder auth uses `{{adminToken}}` (ADMIN role).

Sources: `server/src/modules/admin/*`, shared domains for moderation lists, `web/src/api/httpEndpoints.js` ADMIN.*, `docs/audits/features/admin-panel.md`.

item.name: Dashboard
item.description: Canonical: `GET /admin/dashboard`. There is **no** separate recent-activity endpoint — do not invent one.

request.description:
Headline KPIs (active users, subscribers, revenue, jobs, listings).

**Auth:** ADMIN
**Status:** 200
**Response:** `{ data: { stats: [{ id, label, value, currency? }] } }`

12-month growth/revenue series.

**Auth:** ADMIN
**Query:** year (optional, 2000–2100)
**Status:** 200
**Response:** `{ data: { year, labels, series } }`

**Auth:** ADMIN
**Query:** page, pageSize, sort, search, role (user|supplier|admin), status (active|suspended|banned), plan (free|monthly|yearly)
**Status:** 200

item.name: Profile
item.description: Same `/users/me*` routes as other roles (admin panel profile).

request.description:
**Auth:** any
**Body:** optional firstName, lastName, title, company, country, location, phone, about, aboutExtended, avatarUrl, coverUrl
**Status:** 200

{
  "firstName": "Jane",
  "lastName": "Smith",

  "company": "Acme Labs GmbH",
  "country": "Germany",
  "location": "Berlin, Germany",

item.name: Blogs
item.description: Canonical blogs module (`admin/blogs`). Public read + ADMIN write.

request.description:
With admin token, unpublished posts are included.

**Auth:** optional / ADMIN preferred
**Status:** 200

**Auth:** ADMIN
**Body:** title, category, excerpt, body, image?, readTime?, slug?, publish?
**Status:** 201

body.raw:
{
  "title": "The Future of Lab Automation",
  "category": "Technology",
  "excerpt": "How automation is reshaping modern laboratory workflows.",
  "body": "Full blog content in HTML or Markdown...",
  "image": "https://example.com/images/blog-1.jpg",
  "readTime": "5 min read",
  "slug": "future-of-lab-automation",
  "publish": true
}

item.name: Reports

item.name: Supplier
item.description:
Supplier panel surface. Folder auth uses `{{sellerToken}}` (SUPPLIER role).

**Note:** There is no dedicated `/supplier/dashboard` HTTP API — the frontend dashboard composes advertisements + notifications (see Dashboard folder).

Canonical modules under `server/src/modules/user/*` plus shared contacts/notifications/ads browse. Includes own marketplace listings & recruitment jobs, search, report inbox, and Stripe checkout confirm.
